text:
anna: Heads up: after the routing policy flip we see many SSE sessions closing with proxy 'probe' then immediate client reconnects; billing double counts opens.
raj: Which route? /v1/stream. Any sample conn ids?
anna: shard eu-5, conn=ea12. Ops console shows billing.open x2 within 3s for same session id.
morg: Quick mitigation: suppress open-billing if an open follows a halfclose within 10s and session_id matches. Patch: billing.open_debounce_ms=10000 + require_session_match=true
console-bot: I can add a console annotation and a small tile showing "halfclose->open" counts per tenant to help CS.
ops-bot: ALERT: tenant=t-7 duplicate_open=42 at 1755558899
raj: Do it. Also add a dashboard metric connection.reconnect_reason=probe so we can attribute to routing reclaim.
morg: Rolling debounce to eu-5 as canary. Will monitor for real outage regressions.
anna: Thanks. Can we also add an SDK note urging exponential backoff with jitter on reconnects? That will help.
console-bot: Banner added: "canary: open_billing debounce active on eu-5" and trace sampling increased for /v1/stream for 15m.
ops-bot: NOTE: canary metrics stable, duplicate opens down ~80% for t-7.
raj: Follow-ups: proxy probe -> use non-terminal control frame, SDK backoff doc, and console hint for expected reconnects when reclaim policy active.
anna: Closing loop; will update after 30m.
